summary: Completed comprehensive testing of the new Analytics Dashboard feature. All 5 backend endpoints passed (17/17 tests). Frontend UI testing verified all dashboard components: KPI cards, 5 charts (Client Status, AUM Distribution, Client Spread by City, AUM by Sub-Broker, Monthly Console), Activity Log table (13 rows), year selector, refresh button, and Quick Actions navigation.
passed_tests: Backend: /api/dashboard/summary - Returns 200 with correct structure (clients, sub_brokers, opportunities, aum, trades_count)
Backend: /api/dashboard/clients-by-city - Returns list of cities with counts
Backend: /api/dashboard/aum-distribution - Returns by_asset_class and by_subbroker arrays
Backend: /api/dashboard/activity-log - Returns list with type, status, description, amount, timestamp
Backend: /api/dashboard/monthly-stats - Returns 12 months with investments, trades, clients
Backend: All endpoints require authentication (401/403 without token)
Frontend: KPI cards display correctly (6 clients, 2 sub-brokers, AED 38.14L AUM, 1 bond, 2 RE, 0 trades)
Frontend: Client Status pie chart shows Active clients
Frontend: AUM Distribution pie chart shows Bonds vs Real Estate
Frontend: Client Spread by City horizontal bar chart shows Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Hyderabad
Frontend: AUM by Sub-Broker stacked bar chart with Bond AUM and RE AUM
Frontend: Monthly Console area chart with year selector (2025, 2024, etc.)
Frontend: Year selector changes data correctly
Frontend: Refresh button works and reloads data
Frontend: Activity Log table shows 13 activities with correct headers
Frontend: Quick Actions buttons navigate correctly (tested Manage Bonds)
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard endpoints properly filter data by broker_id for security
AUM calculation correctly sums bond (units_sold * face_value) and real estate (total_cost * invested_percentage)
Activity log aggregates trades, real estate investments, and client creations with proper sorting
Monthly stats correctly parses ISO datetime strings for year filtering
Frontend uses Recharts library effectively for all visualizations
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: Used existing data: 6 clients, 2 sub-brokers, 2 real estate properties (fully invested), 1 bond
